identity_contract.authoritative_source_behavior: The official match_dist_and_match_angle_generate.py sets raw NCI as ue_key_field and base ECI as base_key_field and performs an exact dictionary join.

identity_standard_context.nci: 3GPP/ETSI describes the NR Cell Identity as a 36-bit value whose coding is assigned by the PLMN operator; the observed GNODEB*4096+GCELLID relation is not asserted as a universal 3GPP decoder.

coverage.result: The exact join covers 99.58% of raw rows but is incomplete and must not be represented as complete serving-cell truth.

unmapped_row_profile.source_file_scope: Rows span multiple ground files and two UAV files; no authoritative source field identifies handover, secondary-cell, or base-table version cause.

inconsistent_row.interpretation: One internal raw identity arithmetic inconsistency exists among otherwise mapped rows; it does not explain the 342 missing base keys.

confirmed: The 342 observations reference eight NCI values absent from the 189-row base ECI table.
All eight NCI values are parseable and have internally consistent GNODEB/GCELLID arithmetic.
All 342 rows share the N78/633984/SA/TAC profile.
cause_assessment_for_342.authoritative_explanation: The released metadata supports only a missing-base-key diagnosis. The paper says handover/reselection was allowed and only serving cells were retained, but the raw export has no handover flag, neighbor flag, or base-table version field. It is not legitimate to assign one of those causes to the 342 rows without source-owner clarification.
cause_assessment_for_342.handling: Keep the rows in source-level audit output with unresolved_serving_identity=true; do not nearest-base match or silently discard them.

raw_pci_vs_base_pci_for_mapped_rows.interpretation: PCI is not a deterministic join key or a stable validation oracle for this release.

raw_tac_vs_base_tac_for_mapped_rows.interpretation: TAC agrees where the NCI-to-ECI join exists, but this does not repair the missing keys.

cgi_identity.interpretation: CGI cannot be used as a lossless textual identity without an authoritative reconstruction rule.

field_to_identity_mapping.qualification: 189 base cells mapped; eight raw NCI values remain unresolved.
Described as base-station name/identifier, but no released site identity contract or one-to-many cell grouping is authoritative.
Use only with the source NCI/GNODEB context; not a universal decoding rule.
254 mapped observations disagree with the base value.
Filename labels UAV/ground in this scan but no official route/session schema is defined.

adapter_boundary.reason: A production import would need an authoritative resolution for the 342 missing keys, release/version provenance, and the PCI discrepancies.

required_source_owner_clarifications: Provide the base-station export version/date and the eight missing cell records or explain why they are absent.
Explain the 254 raw/base PCI mismatches across 32 mapped NCI values.
Provide a documented site_id/sector_id/cell_id contract and the intended CGI serialization rule.
State whether the raw table includes only serving cells at every row and how handover/reselection rows should be interpreted.
